intro: "In Favor of the Light" marks a young priest's rite of passage from the isolated training grounds of Coldridge Valley into the wider reaches of Dun Morogh. Instructed by Branstock Khalder, novitiates are sent through the mountain tunnel to Kharanos to further their studies under Priest Trainer Maxan Anvol. It signals that an acolyte is ready to shoulder real responsibilities and earn the traditional vestments of their calling.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Ya been following the Light now for long enough that you find your way to Maxan Anvol in Kharanos. He'll teach ya more about the path yer following, and if you prove worthy, give ya yer first set of robes to denote your station as a priest.
Now get goin'! As soon as yer done here, head through the tunnel—he'll be waitin' for ya.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh, so Branstock sent ya, did he? Good, good! He's right, it is 'bout time you started taking a much larger step into the Light. It'll build character and make ya stronger... An' that's what you'll need more than anything: strength of body... Strength of will.
